environment: Remote Vercel Sandbox, Node.js 22. Source files and tests fetched from the pinned GitHub commit.
execution: All eight existing scripts from npm run check:mcp were run individually.

suites.output:
SDK client passed: 2025-11-25
SDK client passed: 2026-07-28
MCP boundary passed: signed token validation, grant revocation, scope checks, refresh-stable identity, bounded input/output, SDK discovery/tool calls, schema isolation, passive queued projection, and safe errors.

MCP authority profile passed: cryptographic/profile checks precede grant resolution, exact staging audience, mandatory consent binding, strict resource scopes with filtered OAuth scopes, fresh revocation, refresh-stable identity and legacy-store fallback. Provider-issued token profile remains unverified.

WorkOS adapter passed offline fixtures: minimal completion payload, exact identity mapping, client projection, fixed API host, redirect rejection, bounded bodies/deadlines and safe errors. Live token scopes, consent, refresh and revocation remain unverified.

MCP consent/store VM passed: verified member and consent scope intersection, signed client scope ceiling, origin/body/deadline refusal, pending-only completion, failed-flow revocation, provider PKCE/client metadata before activation, read-only refresh binding, and deletion/revocation failclosed. Provider-issued tokens and database locking remain separate verification gates.

MCP connection handoff React checks passed: explicit read/session consent, no automatic grants, Strict Mode duplicate prevention, auth ordering/recovery, owner/transaction cancellation, bounded failures without retries, and safe redirects.
MCP telemetry checks passed: private paths, transactions, encoded redirects, Home work, replay block, and preserved account/public diagnostics.

MCP services/admission passed: passive reads, saved Goal/Guide context, grant and provenance propagation, refresh-safe exact retry, terminal scheduling, context-race denial, safe error mapping, verified readback and scope/owner boundaries. Database atomicity, live provider auth and metered Runtime execution are separate proofs.

MCP provider lifecycle VM passed: no-identity bypass, exact owner/issuer/lease binding, unresolved setup refusal, bounded failures, durable acknowledgment and cleanup retry. Real provider deletion remains a staging acceptance gate.

limitations: Provider, database, and inference boundaries use controlled fixtures. These checks do not prove live OAuth token issuance, SQL locking, Guide entitlements or metered Runtime execution.
No member data was accessed, no paid Session was run, and no production authentication settings were changed.
Grok Bot installation, connection, saved-result retrieval, refresh, revocation, cross-account denial, entitlements and duplicate-charge prevention still require in-app acceptance evidence.
